desc: Establish that every reachable set is a contiguous interval and that expansion order does not affect the maximal closure.
Establish correctness for strict “smaller than current size” conditions and identify terminal blocking slimes.
Derive and implement the Cartesian-tree and weighted-ancestor algorithm.
Prove correctness under strict inequalities and simultaneous left/right expansion.
Validate the implementation on both public samples.
Establish acceptable \(O(N\log N)\) worst-case complexity and memory usage for \(N\le 5\times10^5\).
